title: Honey Bunny Kidz Story Time: 7 Snowy Winter Stories & Songs with Pip Puppy, Lulu Lamb & Mimi Kitten (38 min)

lines.text: Woof! Look! Footprints in the snow! Whose footprints are these?
Two long feet and two little round feet. Hmm!
It's my very first snow day! I want to play with all my friends.
Stay where I can see you, Pip. I'll be right here by the bench.
Okay, Mama! Let's follow the footprints!
Crunch, crunch, crunch!
More footprints! Paw prints, going round and round.
Wait. These look like puppy paws. Whose paw prints are these?
They're mine! I walked in a big circle!
Silly Pip! I was following my own feet! Hee hee!
Hello, Pip! I saw you going round and round. Hee hee!
Honey! Did you make the long footprints? Bunnies hop!
Maybe! Can you hop like a bunny? Hop, hop, hop!
New footprints! Three little toes, like a triangle.
Who waddles and says quack? Whose footprints are these?
Quack, quack! It's me, Dotty! I made the duck footprints!
Dotty! What colour is your cosy scarf?
Pink! And my hat is teal, like the sea.
Let's count my footprints. How many duck footprints?
One, two, three, four! Four duck footprints!
Hello, snow friends! Are your mittens on?
Wiggle your fingers in your mittens. Wiggle, wiggle!
Mama, can we build a snow bunny?
What a good idea! First, we roll snowballs.
Roll, roll, roll! My snowball is getting bigger!
Mine is little. Which snowball is big?
Mine! The big one goes on the bottom.
Lift it up! Big ball on the bottom, small ball on top.
What does a bunny have on top of its head?
Long ears! Just like me!
Pat, pat, pat! Two long snowy ears. Now a happy face!
Two pebble eyes, a pink pebble nose, and twig arms!
And a pebble smile. Count the smile pebbles with me!
One, two, three, four, five! Five smile pebbles!
Brrr! Our snow bunny's paws look chilly.
I brought a spare pair of mittens. What colour are they?
Yellow! Just like mine!
Mittens on! Now our snow bunny is cosy too!
Hooray! Our snow bunny is ready!
Shh! Someone is hopping this way. Who can it be?
Hop, hop, hop!
A little wild bunny! Those first long footprints were hers!
I think she likes our snow bunny. Wave hello! Wave, wave!
Let's sing our Snow Day Song! Stomp, hop and waddle with us!
Paw prints, paw prints, stomp, stomp, stomp! Puppy in the snow goes jump, jump, jump!
Bunny prints, bunny prints, hop, hop, hop! Hop in the snow and never stop!
Duck prints, duck prints, waddle, waddle, wee! Waddle in the snow, follow me!
Snow day, snow day, hip hip hooray! Friends in the snow, let's play, play, play!
Snow day, snow day, hip hip hooray! Friends in the snow, let's play, play, play!
Your noses are pink and your cheeks are cold. Time for a warm drink at home.
Bye bye, snow bunny! We'll see you tomorrow!
One more time! Stomp, hop and waddle with me!
Snow day, snow day, hip hip hooray! Friends in the snow, let's play, play, play!

Woof! Stay cosy, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!

Yay! It's Five Little Snowflakes with Pip Puppy. Let's watch!
Snowflakes falling, soft and slow! Twirling, swirling, down they go!
Snowflakes falling, soft and slow! Twirling, swirling, down they go!
Look up! Big snowflakes! How many can you count?
Five! Five little snowflakes!

scenes.banner: Five Little Snowflakes with Pip Puppy

lines.text: I want to catch one, and keep it for ever and ever!
Ooh! Hold very still, Pip. Shh!
It landed on my nose! Hee hee, it tickles!
Don't move, Pip! Don't sneeze!
Drip!
Hey! Where did my snowflake go? Can you see it?
Hee hee! It's a little drop of water, on the tip of your nose!
Quack, quack! Hello, snow friends!
Dotty! My snowflake turned into water! Why did it melt?
Your nose is warm, Pip! When cold snow gets warm, it melts. Drip!
Let's sing and count! Wiggle your fingers like falling snow!
Five little snowflakes, dancing in the sky.
One fell on Pip's warm nose. Drip! Bye bye!
How many snowflakes are left? Count with me!
Four! Four little snowflakes!
Four little snowflakes, dancing in the sky.
One fell on Lulu's nose. Drip! Bye bye!
Drip!
Oh! How many now? Hold up your fingers!
Three!
Three little snowflakes, dancing in the sky.
One fell on Dotty's beak. Drip! Bye bye!
Quack! A cold beak kiss! How many are left?
Two!
Two little snowflakes, dancing in the sky.
One fell on my warm tummy. Drip! Bye bye!
Only one little snowflake left! Can you point to it?
One little snowflake, dancing in the sky.
It's flying to YOU! Touch your nose!
Drip! Bye bye!
How many snowflakes now?
Zero! I didn't keep a single one!
Don't worry, Pip! Look up! More snow is coming!
Here are two new snowflakes. Which one is big?
That one! The big snowflake! And this one is small.
Watch my wings! Flap, flap, flap!
Whoosh! Are the snowflakes going fast, or slow?
Fast! Swirly and fast!
Now they float down slowly. Can you float down slowly too?
Pip, look! A snowflake on my red mitten. And it's not melting!
Why not? Why didn't it go drip?
Lulu's mitten is cold, like the snow! Cold keeps snowflakes. Warm melts them!
Mama, I wanted to keep a snowflake for ever. But they always melt.
Snowflakes don't stay, Pip. But the whole garden is full of them, to share!
Then let's say hello, and let them fly! Wave hello to the snow!
Let's sing the Five Little Snowflakes Song! Make snowflake fingers!
Snowflakes falling, soft and slow!
Twirling, swirling, down they go!
Five little snowflakes, dancing in the sky,
One fell on a warm, warm nose. Drip! Bye bye!
Four, three, two little snowflakes, dancing in the sky,
Melting on our noses! Drip, drip, drip! Bye bye!
One little snowflake landed on a mitten,
Cold and cosy, like a little white kitten!
Twirl around! Snowflakes falling, soft and slow! Twirling, swirling, down they go!

Woof! Bye bye, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!
Are you ready for the next story? Say, yes!
Yay! It's Lulu Lamb's First Snowflakes. Let's watch!
Look up! Something soft and white is falling from the sky! What is it?
Snow! It's snowing, Lulu!
My very first snowflakes! Wheee!
I want to catch a snowflake and show it to Pip!
Got one! Oh... where did it go? Can you see it?
Your snowflake is white, and the snow is white too. It's hiding!
Hmm. I'm white too! I can hide in the snow!
Shh! Where's Lulu? Can you find me?
Hee hee! I can see two pink ears and a purple bow!
Peekaboo! Oh! A snowflake landed on my nose!
It tickles! Hee hee hee!
Silly Lulu! Now I can see it, on your pink nose!
Hello, my snowy friends! Lulu, I know a snowflake trick.
White snowflakes are easy to see on bright colours.
Bright colours? Let's find colours in the snow!
My earmuffs! What colour are my earmuffs?
Pink! A snowflake is on my pink earmuff. I can see it!
And my scarf! What colour is my scarf?
Blue! Blue with white dots... or are they snowflakes? Hee hee!
Now hold out your mittens, Lulu. What colour are Lulu's mittens?
Red! Bright red mittens! Catch, snowflakes, catch!
Look! Snowflakes are falling on my red mittens. Now I can see them!
Let's count them! How many snowflakes?
One, two, three, four, five! Five snowflakes!
Look very closely. Every snowflake has little pointy arms.
How many arms? Count with me!
One, two, three, four, five, six! Six arms!
Yes! Six arms. And every snowflake is a little bit different.
Just like friends! All different, all special.
Snowflakes twirl and swirl. Can you twirl like a snowflake? Spin around!
Twirl, twirl, and float down softly. Wheee!
Crunch, crunch, crunch!
Someone is coming. Who's that?
A snowy puppy! Can you guess who it is?
It's me, Pip! Woof! Snow fell from a tree, right on me!
Hee hee! Pip, you look like a snow puppy!
Look! White snowflakes on Pip's brown ears! They are so easy to see!
How many snowflakes are on Pip's ears?
Four! Four snowflakes! Hee hee, they tickle!
Pip, these are my very first snowflakes! I wanted to show you.
They're beautiful, Lulu! Now let's catch them together!
Let's take a snowy breath first. Breathe in the cold air, slowly...
Now blow it out. Look, a little cloud! Can you do it too?
Let's sing our Snowflake Song!
Snowflakes falling, soft and white. Twirling, swirling, oh so light!
Land on red and land on blue. One for me, and one for you!
Six little arms, so sparkly and small. Every snowflake, I love them all!
Wiggle your fingers, fall down slow. Hello, hello, hello, first snow!
One more time! Wiggle your fingers like snowflakes and sing with me!
Snowflakes falling, soft and white. Twirling, swirling, oh so light!

Yay! It's Lulu Lamb's Mitten Song. Let's watch!
Clap, clap!
Hat, scarf, mittens, boots! Ready for the snow! Wiggle ten warm fingers, and off we go!
Woof! Let's go play in the snow, Lulu!
Wait! Lulu, where's your hat? Where's your scarf?
Oops! I forgot! It's cold outside. Can you help me get dressed?
I found a red mitten! Does a mitten go on my ear?
No, silly Lulu! Hee hee! What goes on your hands?
Mittens! Hee hee! Mittens go on my hands!
Let's start at the top, Lulu. What goes on your head?
A hat! My cosy hat!
Hat goes on my head, pull it down, down, down!
What colour is Lulu's hat?
Yellow! Like the sunshine!
Pull your hat down too. Down, down, down!
Next, my scarf! Where does a scarf go?
Round your neck. Round and round!
Scarf goes round my neck, round and round and round!
What colour is Lulu's scarf?
Blue, with little white dots!
Now my mitten. How many hands do I have?
Two hands! So I need two mittens. But I only have one!
First, let's count ten warm fingers. Hold up your hands!
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Where is my other red mitten? Can you see it?
Hmm. Not on the bench. Not on the rug.
Let's put on your boots, and then we'll look again.
What goes on my feet?
Boots! Green boots! Left foot, right foot!
Squish! Squeak!
Something is in my boot! What can it be? Guess!
My other mitten! It was hiding in my boot!
Hee hee! A mitten in a boot! Silly mitten!
Well done for looking, Lulu.
Mittens on my hands, thumbs go in, hooray!
Can you find your thumbs? Wiggle, wiggle!
Boots on too! How many cosy things am I wearing? Count them!
Hat, scarf, mittens, boots. Four cosy things!
Now let's sing the whole Mitten Song! Do the actions with us!
Hat goes on my head, pull it down, down, down!
Scarf goes round my neck, round and round and round!
Mittens on my hands, thumbs go in, hooray!
Boots go on my feet, stomp, stomp, let's play!
Hat, scarf, mittens, boots! Ready for the snow! Wiggle ten warm fingers, and off we go!
You're ready! Now we can go out in the snow together.
Crunch, crunch, crunch!
I'm warm and cosy, from my head to my toes!
Can you stomp in the snow like us? Stomp, stomp!
Stay close to me, my snow friends.
One more time! Wiggle your ten fingers and sing!
Hat, scarf, mittens, boots! Ready for the snow! Wiggle ten warm fingers, and off we go!

Are you ready for the next story? Say, yes!
Yay! It's Pip Puppy's Warm Coat Hunt. Let's watch!
Brrr! Who has the warmest coat? Lulu, Dotty, or the little birds? Point to it!
Hmm! Let's find out together!
Mama, my fur coat feels chilly today. Brrr!
Let's visit our friends and ask how they stay warm.
Stay close to me, Pip.
Okay, Mama! But first, I need something warm!
Mm! Mm mm mm!
Oh, Pip! You wrapped my long scarf round and round and round!
Where is Pip's nose? Can you see it?
It's under here! Hee hee! Too much scarf!
Lulu, how do you stay warm in the snow?
I have a fluffy coat that grows all by itself. What is my coat made of?
Wool! Soft, cosy wool!
Can I feel it? Pat, pat, pat. Ooh! So squishy!
Pat, pat, pat with Pip! Pat your tummy too!
Is my wool thick or thin?
Thick! Thick wool is like a big fluffy blanket.
Quack, quack! Hello, friends!
Dotty, you don't have wool. How do you stay warm?
Do I have fur or feathers? Shout it out!
Feathers! Under my top feathers, I have soft, fluffy ones.
Look! A tiny fluffy feather. It's so light. Whoosh!
What colour is Dotty's fluffy feather?
Yellow! Like the sun!
Fluffy feathers keep me warm!
Tweet, tweet!
Look up! Little birds on the branch!
How many birds can you see? Count with me!
One, two, three! Three little birds!
Puff!
Whoa! The birds went puff! Now they look like round, fluffy balls!
Birds puff up their feathers to keep the warm air close.
Let's puff up like a bird! Big breath in, and puff!
Now flap your little wings. Flap, flap, flap!
Lulu has wool. Dotty has feathers. Birds puff up. I only have fur.
Is fur a warm coat too?
Yes, Pip! Your fur is your very own coat. In winter, puppy fur grows thick and cosy.
Pip! Pip! You forgot your hat, your scarf and your mittens!
Honey! Thank you! Fur and a hat. Double cosy!
Now I'm warm! What colour is my hat?
Red! And my mittens are yellow!
Rub your paws together. Rub, rub, rub! Feel them get warm?
So who has the warmest coat? Lulu, Dotty, or the birds?
I know! The warmest is all of us, snuggled together!
Snuggle close, everyone! Give yourself a big, warm hug too!
Let's sing the Warm Coat Song! Do the actions with us!
Little lamb has woolly wool. Baa, baa! Pat, pat, pat!
Little duck has fluffy feathers. Quack, quack! Flap, flap, flap!
Little bird goes puffy puff. Tweet, tweet! Puff, puff, puff!
Little puppy has fuzzy fur. Woof, woof! Wag, wag, wag!
Warm coat, warm coat, snug as can be! A warm, cosy coat for you and me!
One more time! Wag and sing with me!
Warm coat, warm coat, snug as can be! A warm, cosy coat for you and me!

Yay! It's Five Little Stars with Ollie Owl and Pip Puppy. Let's watch!
Twinkle up, twinkle down, little stars all around!
Twinkle up, twinkle down, shh, shh, not a sound!
Twinkle!
Tonight we're star watchers! How many stars can you see?

scenes.banner: Five Little Stars with Ollie Owl and Pip Puppy

lines.text: Hmm. No stars yet, Pip. The sky is still pink.
But I want all the stars, right now!
Stars come out slowly, Pip. One by one, when the sky gets dark.
Slowly? Oh, waiting is so hard!
Wait! Look! A little light! Is it a star?
Blink, blink!
Hee hee! Stars don't have wings, Pip. It's a firefly!
Oh! It landed on my nose! Hee hee, it tickles!
Bye bye, little firefly! Can you wave bye bye too?
Hoo, hoo!
Who said hoo-hoo, up in the apple tree? Can you guess?
Hoo-hoo! It's me, Ollie Owl! Let's wait together, and count the stars as they come out.
Okay. I'll be a good star watcher, and wait.
Look up, high in the sky! Here comes the first star!
One little star! Hello, star! What colour is this little star?
Yellow! A yellow star!
Another one! How many stars now? Count with me!
One, two! Two little stars! This one is pink!
And here comes a star like the sky in the day. What colour is it?
Blue! One, two, three! Three little stars!
Four... and five! Can you hold up five fingers?
Five little stars! Waiting was worth it!
Star watchers can make pictures with the stars. Look!
Three stars, joined with a line. What shape is it?
A triangle! Three stars and three sides!
My turn! Four stars. One, two, three, four. What shape is this?
A square! Four sides, just like a little box.
Ooh, look at these stars! Can you make this shape with your hands?
A heart! A big star heart, for Mama!
Aww, thank you, Pip. Now look up!
Whoa! So many stars! Can we count them all?
Hoo-hoo! Too many to count! The whole sky is twinkling!
And look who's coming up! Who is that, big and bright?
Good evening, little star watchers! Shall we sing a star lullaby together?
The Five Little Stars Song! Make twinkle fingers with us!
One little star says hello, hello!
Two little stars, all in a row!
Three little stars, so twinkly bright!
Four little stars say night night, night night!
Five little stars, up in the sky,
Sing me a sleepy lullaby!
Twinkle up, twinkle down, five little stars all around!
Twinkle up, twinkle down, shh, shh, not a sound.
Now let's be sleepy stars. Stretch your arms out wide, like a big star!
Breathe in slowly, and breathe out. Whoosh.
Now curl up small, like a sleepy puppy. Can you curl up too?
Goodnight, five little stars! Goodnight, Ollie!
Goodnight, Pip! I'll keep watch all night. Hoo-hoo!
Can you wave goodnight to the stars?
One more time, with twinkle fingers! Twinkle up, twinkle down, five little stars all around! Twinkle up, twinkle down, shh, shh, not a sound.

Yay! It's Pip Puppy and Mimi's Warm Socks Bedtime. Let's watch!
Ooh! Cold toes! Cold toes! Hop, hop, hop!
What can I put on my cold toes? Shout it out!
Socks! Warm, cosy socks!

scenes.banner: Pip Puppy and Mimi's Warm Socks Bedtime

lines.text: It's my sleepover at your house, Mimi. But my toes are too chilly to sleep!
Don't worry, Pip. I have a basket full of socks! Meow!
Wow! So many socks! Which one first?
Pick one, Pip! Pull, pull, pull!
Ta-da! I'm all ready for bed!
Hee hee! A sock on your ear? Does a sock go on your ear?
No! Socks go on your feet! Silly me!
Let's play a sock colour game!
What colour is this sock?
Red! With little white hearts!
And this one? What colour?
Yellow! With orange dots, like little oranges!
Stripy, stripy! What colour are the stripes on this sock?
Green and white! Like a candy stick!
Ooh, my favourite! Blue with yellow stars! Count the stars with me!
One, two, three stars!
Socks come in twos. Two socks make a pair!
Red and red. Is that a pair? Yes or no?
Yes! Two red socks! A pair!
Yellow and green. Is that a pair?
No! They don't match. Silly socks!
Now we have pairs! How many pairs can you count?
One, two, three pairs!
Look, I put on one blue star sock. But where is the other blue sock?
Is it under the rug? No.
Listen! What is that jingle in my bed?
My blue sock! It's in Mimi's bed!
Oh! My yarn ball was snuggled inside it like a little blanket! Hee hee!
One sock, two socks! Wiggle your toes with me!
Ahh! My toes are warm and cosy now!
Mine too!
Who wants a warm milk cuddle before bed?
Me! Me! Pad, pad, pad in our socks!
I made it just warm, not hot. Stay close to me.
How many cups are on the table?
Two! One for Pip, and one for me!
Mmm! What do we say to Mama Bunny?
Thank you! Meow!
Now a big, cosy cuddle. Look, soft, sleepy snow is falling outside.
Time for a sleepy kitten stretch! Paws up high, high, high!
Now wiggle your warm toes. Wiggle, wiggle!
Now slow breaths. Breathe in, like smelling warm milk.
And breathe out, slow and soft. Ahh.
Yes, Moon! Let's sing the Warm Socks Song! Wiggle along!
One sock, two socks, on my feet. Wiggle, wiggle, toes so sweet!
Red socks, blue socks, find a pair. Warm and cosy everywhere!
Warm socks, cosy socks, snug and tight. Warm socks help me sleep tonight!
Warm socks, cosy socks, snug and tight. Warm socks help me sleep tonight!
Yawn! Goodnight, Pip.
Goodnight, Mimi. Goodnight, warm toes.
Wiggle your toes and say goodnight with me. Goodnight!
